Whether you’re launching an MVP, redesigning your product, or scaling your platform—Techmorph acts as your tech partner from idea to deployment.

records.name: RouteBoy
records.tagline: Find the best route with cheaper fair price
records.description: Routeboy is a clean, human-friendly way to get directions without the clutter. It focuses on what matters most: your location, your destination, and the clearest route between them. No bloated maps or endless taps just fast, simple navigation that works for walking, driving, and real everyday movement. Built around how people actually find their way, not how maps assume they do.

records.name: Drylendar
records.tagline: Track drinks to create a motivating calendar day after day!
records.description: Drylendar is the most friendly alcohol tracker on the App Store. It has been designed to be very simple to use to produce an understandable calendar you can share with your friends. As much features are free to use, you can subscribe to a Premium Plan to get the best of the app (no ads, daily reminders, verified badge…)

records.name: CogniMemo Extension
records.tagline: AI memory tool that lives where you work
records.description: CogniMemo helps your AI remember. It adds long-term memory to ChatGPT and other AI tools. You can type @cogni in any chat to search your saved notes, past chats, and content. It works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek. You can save posts from X/Twitter, archive your AI conversations, and use a floating assistant on any website to explain or write using your own knowledge. Everything stays organized in one fast, searchable place—and your data stays under your control.

records.name: Unreel UGC
records.tagline: Your AI video content team that posts while you sleep
records.description: Unreel turns the $500/video UGC grind into an unlimited content engine. No more hiring creators, waiting for deliverables, or endless editing. Just tell Unreel what you're selling. It researches trending hooks, writes scripts, generates AI avatars, edits with proper pacing and then publishes directly to TikTok - all on autopilot. Built for Ecommerce/TikTok Shop sellers and affiliate marketers who need 3-5 videos/day but can't burn $50K/month on creators. Own your content pipeline, not rent it.

records.name: StoryLearn
records.tagline: Explore English with Adventures
records.description: A product of Story Learn offers an innovative approach to language learning by combining engaging stories with interactive games

records.name: LovoLemon Platform
records.tagline: Dating Redefined: No Swiping, Just Real Connections
records.description: Choosing a life partner involves so much more. I realized there was a gap for a platform that prioritizes compatibility over the "swipe." We wanted to create a space where you can actually find someone who fits your life, not just someone who looks good in a photo.

records.name: Swiss Cantons for Company Registration
records.tagline: Best Swiss Cantons for Company Registration & Lower Taxes
records.description: Seamless Company Registration in Switzerland with Enterslice favorable rates, innovation hub. Full support from bank setup to registry. No-Cost Consultation

records.name: Relayt ai
records.tagline: conversation to conversion
records.description: Relayt treats every chat as a lead, tracks what’s open or going cold, and lets admins jump into live conversations in real time. Lead capture is built in from the start, and chats connect directly to follow-ups and campaigns in the same system. It’s multi-tenant, website-aware, and designed for SMBs that want visibility and conversions, not complex CRM setups.

records.name: LED Banner
records.tagline: LED Banner，LED Scroller ，Banner make，running text,tool box,
records.description: Create stunning, customizable LED banners with full control over text, style, and speed. Pause and play your message on demand and export your designs as professional videos. This is the first step in our journey to become your all-in-one toolkit—replacing multiple apps with a single, powerful platform for all your needs.

records.name: Portfolix EMS
records.tagline: Human-centered workforce management for teams that move fast
records.description: Most employee management systems were built for Fortune 500. Portfolix EMS is built for growing teams that need simplicity, not complexity. 🚀 Mobile-first: One-tap attendance. Real-time dashboards on your phone—not tethered to web browsers. 🤝 Human-centered: Visibility without surveillance. See who's present, on task, or delayed—so you can help, not hover. ⚡ Unified platform: Attendance + tasks + leaves + Payroll + Performance in one app. No tool-switching.

records.name: Opttab
records.tagline: Manage your presence in AI search
records.description: Opttab is an all-in-one AI visibility and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) platform designed to help brands, individuals, and businesses measure, control, and grow their presence across AI-powered search engines and LLMs such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and other AI models. Unlike traditional SEO tools, Opttab focuses on how AI models discover, interpret, rank, and reuse your content—giving you full transparency and control over your AI-facing digital footprint.

records.name: Human Replies to Google Reviews
records.tagline: Responding to reviews generates more reviews, by humans
records.description: 100% Human-Managed Reputation for the AI Era. In 2026, customers can smell a generic AI review response from a mile away. ReplyRightly is a boutique service designed for local businesses (Doctors, Lawyers, HVAC, and more) who want to build real trust, not just fill space with bot-slop.

records.name: Epyox
records.tagline: Detect deepfakes, manipulated content, and AI-generated.
records.description: Advanced forensic analysis for PDFs and Images using Deep Learning. Detect deepfakes, manipulated content, and AI-generated media with 96% accuracy.

records.name: PostSyncer
records.tagline: AI Content Maker, for Social Media Publishing
records.description: The most powerful tool to manage all your social accounts at scale. Create, schedule, and reply across 10+ platforms. Get inspiration from the viral content library, generate media with AI (Sora, Veo & more), connect unlimited accounts and manage clients in dedicated workspaces.

records.name: ErectogenX
records.tagline: ErectogenX Now! Supplements - health
records.description: ErectogenX is a premium dietary supplement designed for men. Its blend of carefully selected vitamins, minerals, and plant extracts supports overall wellness and vitality. Zinc contributes to the maintenance of normal testosterone levels¹. Made under strict European quality standards, ErectogenX is non-GMO, free from artificial colors and preservatives, and contains no synthetic hormones. Take 2 capsules daily with water.

records.name: Lumpos
records.tagline: Turn CV piles into top hires fast.
records.description: Unlike traditional ATS that rely on outdated keyword matching, Lumpos uses AI to "read" resumes like a human. We don’t just filter; we Rank. The standout feature is our Smart Scoring Engine: it processes 1,000 CVs in under a minute to surface your top 10% candidates, eliminating false negatives. Plus, our built-in ROI Dashboard visualizes time saved and pipeline velocity—turning recruitment data into actionable insights for high-volume hiring.

records.name: MyStreakBook
records.tagline: Build habits with streaks, not motivation
records.description: Most habit apps rely on motivation, reminders, or gamification. Those fail when life gets busy. MyStreakBook focuses on one thing that actually drives consistency: visible streaks. Every habit is tracked as proof of showing up, not perfection. No pressure to be ideal. No guilt for missing a day. Just clear visibility of effort over time. Built for people who want consistency to survive real life, not just good intentions.

records.name: Ultra Toolbox
records.tagline: 13+ minimalist, ad-free tools for modern devs & creators
records.description: Tired of ad-bloated, slow utility sites? Ultra Toolbox is a curated suite of 13+ lightweight tools built for speed and privacy. Key tools: • YouTube Comment Extractor (Export to Excel) • JSON to Table (Flatten nested data) • WiFi QR Generator • Base64, Case Converter, & more. No tracking, no ads, just pure utility. Built with 100/100 PageSpeed scores to get you in and out fast.

records.name: Smoothdev.io
records.tagline: Write Code, Not Docs
records.description: Smoothdev automates tedious software documentation processes across the SDLC. Our ai engine analyzes code diffs to generate meaningful, standardized commit messages, structured PR summaries, and comprehensive release notes with categorized changes. Unlike tools that handle one doc type, everything is done in a single CLI integrated into your Git workflow.

records.name: CapitanPro
records.tagline: Marketing pilot for your growth
records.description: CapitanPro is a marketing pilot that's designed to guide you through the sophisticated world of marketing.

records.name: Brickosquare
records.tagline: A challenging 9x9 block puzzle!
records.description: Brickosquare stands out in the crowded block puzzle genre (think classics like Block Blast, Woodoku or Blockudoku, which often use 8x8 or 10x10 grids) by offering a challenging 9x9 Sudoku-inspired grid that adds extra strategic depth and space for smarter placements—perfect for players who find smaller boards too restrictive but want more logic than pure chaos. You can also customize your blocks, grid and background. Like chess? Play on a chessboard grid. Compete on leaderboard!

records.name: Image to Text OCR Converter
records.tagline: Turn images into text. Fast, accurate & effortless OCR
records.description: Convert images into editable text in seconds. Upload photos, screenshots, or scanned documents and get clean, accurate text instantly. Built for speed and simplicity, this OCR tool removes the hassle of manual typing. Perfect for notes, receipts, documents, and everyday productivity—no clutter, no learning curve, just results. If you want it more technical, more casual, or more premium-sounding, I can refine the tone in one shot.

records.name: Tool Vault
records.tagline: 100+ Free Converters, Generators, & Calculators!
records.description: I created Tool Vault as a fun side project to see how 1 guy compares to 40 person companies doing the same thing. ive worked really hard on this and am excited to continue working on this project. I wont stop at 100 tools (were past that) i wont stop at 500 tools, i wont stop at 1,000.

records.name: KIS
records.tagline: Explain complex text in plain English
records.description: KIS focuses on clarity, not verbosity. It takes complex or dense text and explains it in plain English without jargon, filler, or unnecessary detail. It’s deliberately simple and fast, designed for moments when you just want to understand something without wading through long explanations or opinions.

records.name: Dream & Love
records.tagline: The shared vision board for couples who dream big.
records.description: The ultimate shared space for ambitious couples. Create a joint Vision Board, track life goals, and count down to your big moments together. Whether it's a wedding, a house, or a reunion, Dream & Love gamifies your future to keep the flame alive.

records.name: CallSetter AI
records.tagline: Conversational AI for inbound lead qualification
records.description: CallSetter AI is a conversational AI platform that contacts inbound leads in real time, qualifies them based on predefined criteria, and automatically books appointments into a company’s calendar. It is built for businesses that rely on inbound lead generation and need faster speed to lead, higher contact rates, and consistent follow up without adding headcount. The platform integrates with CRM and advertising workflows.

records.name: SkipSetup
records.tagline: Fully wired full-stack TS apps with hallucination-free AI
records.description: SkipSetup is the AI-native foundation for full-stack TypeScript apps: Generate a fully wired, production-ready stack in one command, integrating Better-Auth, Stripe, Resend (emails), Prisma, tRPC, and more, using curated T3 templates. Thekiro AI brain includes specialist agents and live specs, eliminating hallucinations so AI adds features perfectly on the first try. - Small: Lean MVP - Medium: Complete SaaS (<90s) Try: npx skipsetup-cli@latest create my-app --size medium

records.name: Verb Ecosystem
records.tagline: Multi-protocol server library and ecosystem for Bun.
records.description: A fast, modern server framework for Bun with multi-protocol support. Verb is a server library built from scratch for Bun. Not ported from Node.js. Started as a simple HTTP library. Got a little carried away. What's included: - Verb: Multi-protocol server (HTTP, WebSocket, gRPC, TCP, UDP) - Hull: Database toolkit (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) - Allow: Authentication (JWT, OAuth, local) - Shelves: S3-compatible storage - Hoist: Self-hosted deployment

records.name: Auto Mind Maping
records.tagline: Let's you visualise your conversations with AI
records.description: Turns every back-and-forth with your AI into a branching, living mind map that updates in real time. Instead of scrolling through walls of chat text, you see each question, answer, and follow-up as connected nodes you can drag around, annotate, and export. It feels intuitive built on top of ReactFlow. It’s ideal for research, brainstorming, and presentations and can show “how we got here” at a glance.

records.name: Newsopia
records.tagline: From news to understanding
records.description: Newsopia doesn’t just summarize news — it explains what it means and why it matters. Instead of endless headlines, it breaks events into clear context, real-world implications, and personal impact. The focus is on understanding over consumption, helping users make sense of markets, geopolitics, and daily life without noise or overwhelm.

records.name: Bookmark Assistant
records.tagline: Sync Chrome bookmarks to Notion with rich metadata.
records.description: Transform your Chrome bookmarks into an organized Notion database with one click. Bookmark Assistant is a production-ready extension that automatically extracts descriptions, syncs changes, and keeps your bookmarks perfectly organized in Notion—no manual copying required.
